author: ARANI BASU
description: The Indian team went through a change in fitness testing drills after Adrian Leroux replaced Soham Desai as the strength and conditioning coach last year. It is learnt that the BCCI medical team, which includes the CoE and the Indian team, has struggled to work in sync to assess the fitness of players. Since Leroux took over, it was decided that the Bronco test would be the primary test to judge fitness instead of the Yo-Yo test.
title: BCCI to standardise Bronco, 2K fitness test parameters after ENG tour debacle

author: SOUMITRA BOSE
description: A 20-year-old BBA student faces abduction and sexual assault charges. He is demanding luxury amenities and refusing police questioning. The accused also refuses medical treatment and to share passwords. He alleges police highhandedness and theft of cash from his flat. Police are monitoring him for self-harm and seeking digital evidence.
title: Nagpur rape accused wants soft bedding, pizza in lock-up: Cops

author: TNN
description: The government has directed online intermediaries to block 7,393 links involved in film piracy. This action includes the blocking of 4,996 Telegram channels and 1,263 websites. The information and broadcasting ministry disclosed this directive to the Lok Sabha on Wednesday. This move follows amendments to the Cinematograph Act in 2023. The legal framework against online film piracy has been strengthened by the government.
title: Government orders blocking of 7,393 links involved in film piracy

author: TNN
description: Prime Minister Modi emphasised the significant transformation taking place in Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. The repeal of Article 370 opened a new chapter, leading to increased infrastructure and opportunities in the region. Empowerment and constitutional rights have been extended to women and marginalized communities, marking the beginning of a new era characterized by peace and progress for these Union territories.
title: Life's changed in J&K, Ladakh since Article 370, 35(A) repeal: PM Modi

author: TNN
description: In a strong rebuttal, India rejected Pakistan's Youm-e-Istehsal, deeming it as propaganda intended to obscure its own human rights abuses and terrorism connections. The Indian government asserted that the constitutional changes in Jammu and Kashmir fall within its sovereignty, whilst the global community takes note of the human rights oppression occurring in Pakistan-administered regions. Pakistan is called upon to address ongoing bloodshed and relinquish its illegal occupation of Indian territories.
title: Government hits out at Pakistan’s malicious propaganda against India

title: Cabinet secretary and home secretary get one-year extensions

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Almost three-quarters of Asian oak species find themselves without live representations in botanical gardens, putting countless vulnerable trees in danger of extinction. Agriculture and logging pose significant threats to these essential forest ecosystems. To combat this, immediate fieldwork and seed collection efforts are being organized to safeguard endangered species. The overarching objective of these conservation actions is to create managed collections that can facilitate future reintroduction efforts.
title: 54 Asian oak species reviewed: 40 have no backup, 1 may be extinct in the wild

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Jana Nayagan's box office collections saw a further slowdown on its fourteenth day. The action drama collected an estimated Rs 1.80 crore in India on Wednesday. Its India net collection has now reached Rs 183.35 crore after fourteen days. Worldwide gross collections for the film have now crossed Rs 306 crore. Tamil Nadu remained the strongest performing market for the film.
title: Jana Nayagan day 14: Thalapathy Vijay film drops 14.3%, India net at Rs 183.35 crore

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
description: After enduring twenty-two long years of wrongful imprisonment, a man was finally acquitted by the Supreme Court. The injustice stemmed from the trial court's flawed evidence analysis, compounded by the High Court's refusal to entertain his delayed appeal. The Supreme Court emphasized how marginalized communities often find access to justice frustratingly elusive, shedding light on the pressing issues within the judicial system that disproportionately affect the underprivileged.
title: Supreme Court acquits man after 22 years in jail for wrongful conviction
